scope: Evidence review before Super Miner ramping damage or underground behavior is enabled.

sources.title: December Update
sources.finding: Supercell establishes that Super Miner attacks increase in damage over time and separately changes above-ground movement of underground units by 30%.

sources.title: New In Town Hall 16!
sources.finding: Supercell publishes Super Miner level 10 as 3,800 HP and 640/2,000 DPS, confirming a damage range but not stage timing or reset conditions.

sources.title: Pinned normalized Miner superTroop payload
sources.finding: The pinned payload supplies parent levels and ordinary values but lacks ramp-stage, timer, reset, underground-targeting and damage-on-death lifecycle fields.

established: Super Miner is an in-scope permanent Home Village Super Troop whose attack damage increases over time.
The published level-10 notation establishes 640 through 2,000 DPS, but not the intermediate progression.
The global above-ground movement adjustment is not a Super Miner-specific underground timing contract.
unresolved: No source gives the number of damage stages, exact values, duration per stage, first-hit value, attack cadence, reset on target loss, reset on underground movement, or interaction with Rage and Freeze.
No source identifies the Super Miner underground transition timing, vulnerability, trap triggering, target retention, pathfinding, collision or reappearance position for the frozen TH18 version.
No version-identified source establishes damage-on-death behavior, radius, delay, target filtering or its relationship to destruction ordering.
decision: Do not enable super_miner in Core, GUI or RL until a version-identified ramp-stage and underground/death lifecycle contract is available. Do not reuse the ordinary Miner burrow flag, Inferno stages, or a generic death explosion as a substitute.
